question: Mr. Patrick teaches math to \(15\) students. He was grading tests and found that when he graded everyone’s test except Payton’s, the average grade for the class was \(80.\) After he graded Payton’s test, the class average became \(81.\) What was Payton’s score on the test?
solution:
Multiplying an average by the number of scores gives their total. Before Payton's test was included, there were \(14\) scores, totaling \(14\cdot80=1120\). Afterward, all \(15\) scores totaled \(15\cdot81=1215\).

The only added score was Payton's, so it was
\[
1215-1120=\boxed{95},
\]
choice E.
